sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject. Preserve the prior instructions and the existing appliedIcePressure result, canonical datatypes/units, same-case loadPatchLength/iceLoadAreaFactorCa pairing, and required coverage counts. The direct-analysis location model remains semantically incorrect: sh:xone makes the five vertical and horizontal alternatives mutually exclusive within each case, although a location case must retain the required vertical and horizontal position structure; its branches also do not prohibit or coherently pair competing position properties. Replace this with explicit, non-accidental case constraints that associate each required vertical alternative (including its declared UIWL/LIWL reference operand) and horizontal alternative with the appropriate directAnalysisCase nodes, while enforcing several distinct intermediate and other-horizontal cases.
